newsitem.title: USA: Personnel Group evaluating sale of unit.
newsitem.headline: Personnel Group evaluating sale of unit.

text.p: Personnel Group of America Inc said Tuesday it is evaluating the possible sale of its Nursefinders division.
To assist with the evaluation, the company said it has retained Goldsmith, Agio, Helms and Co, an investment banking firm based in Minneapolis, as its exclusive financial adviser.
Nursefinders, based in Arlington, Texas, is a provider of home healthcare and supplemental staffing services and related products, the company said.

Through its national network of 100 company-operated, franchised and licensed offices, Nursefinders generated revenues of $122.9 million in 1996 and $33.2 million in the first quarter of 1997, and EBITDA of $8.4 million and $2.2 million, respectively, the company said.
At March 30, Nursefinders had assets of $64.6 million and working capital of $14.7 million.
